waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at your waist

seatEase.name: Seat ease (%)
seatEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at your seat

kneeEase.name: Knee ease (%)
kneeEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at the knee

waistHeight.name: Waist height (%)
waistHeight.help: Controls the height of the waist, 100% = waist height, 0% = hip height

crotchDrop.name: Crotch drop (%)
crotchDrop.help: Lowers the crotch for a more relaxed fit

fitKnee.name: Fit the knee
fitKnee.help: Fits the legs from based on the knee circumference, rather than seat circumference

waistAngle.name: Waistband angle (°)
waistAngle.help: Change the angle of the waistband when viewed from the side

useWaistAngleFor.name: Use waistband angle for
useWaistAngleFor.help: Apply the waistband angle to the front, back or both

lengthInseam.name: Length at Inseam (%)
lengthInseam.help: How long the inseam of the shorts should be. 100% = floor length, 40-50% = knee length.

cuffWidth.name: Cuff Width (%)
cuffWidth.help: How wide to make the leg cuffs.

pocketDepth.name: Pocket Depth (%)
pocketDepth.help: How far below the waist the pockets should end. Measure from your waist to where your fingertips fall on your side.

frontPanelPercentage.name: Front Panel Width (%)
frontPanelPercentage.help: What proportion of the front of the pants should be taken up by the front panel.

pocketOpeningDepth.name: Pocket Opening Depth (%)
pocketOpeningDepth.help: How deep the pocket openings should be. They can't be shallower than the necessary front opening.

pocketFacingUnderlap.name: Pocket Facing Underlap (%)
pocketFacingUnderlap.help: How far the pockets, pocket facings, and waist side pieces extend under the front panel

pocketBottomCurve.name: Pocket Bottom Curve (%)
pocketBottomCurve.help: Adjusts the curve of the bottom of the pocket opening

pocketCurveControl.name: Pocket Curve Control (%)
pocketCurveControl.help: Adjust the curve of the bottom of the pocket bag

frontPleat.name: Front Pleat
frontPleat.help: Whether to generate a pleat on the front panel.

frontPleatPosition.name: Front Pleat Position (%)
frontPleatPosition.help: Where to generate a pleat on the front panel.

frontPleatWidth.name: Front Pleat Width (%)
frontPleatWidth.help: How big of a pleat to generate on the front panel.

frontPleatDisplayLength.name: Front Pleat Preview Length (%)
frontPleatDisplayLength.help: How far to draw the pleat preview lines. This doesn't affect shaping at all.

slashIterations.name: Slash Iterations
slashIterations.help: How many cuts to make to spread the body panels. Turn this up if it looks jagged.

hemRatio.name: Hem Ratio (%)
hemRatio.help: How far the bottom hem should be flared, relative to the same height on a basic Titan. This is very approximate. The flare won't go past 90 degrees total.

spread.name: Spread
spread.help: Whether to slash and spread the body panels.

legBalance.name: Leg balance (%)
legBalance.help: Controls the ratio between front and back panel of the leg

crossSeamCurveStart.name: Start of the cross seam curve (%)
crossSeamCurveStart.help: Controls how far into the cross seam we start to curve

crossSeamCurveBend.name: Cross seam bend (%)
crossSeamCurveBend.help: Controls the curvature of the cross seam

crossSeamCurveAngle.name: Cross seam angle (°)
crossSeamCurveAngle.help: Controls the angle of the cross seam

crotchSeamCurveStart.name: Start of the crotch seam curve (%)
crotchSeamCurveStart.help: Controls how far into the crotch seam we start to curve

crotchSeamCurveBend.name: Crotch seam bend (%)
crotchSeamCurveBend.help: Controls the curvature of the crotch seam

crotchSeamCurveAngle.name: Crotch seam angle (°)
crotchSeamCurveAngle.help: Controls the angle of the crotch seam

waistBalance.name: Waist balance (%)
waistBalance.help: Controls the horizontal position of the waist relative to the seat

grainlinePosition.name: Grainline position (%)
grainlinePosition.help: Controls the horizontal position of the leg relative to the seat
